$comment: IMP-15: the last four rows make the KMS shadow real in the happy path.
22222222… is the key kms-aliases.json DOES reach (via alias/app-data) — discovered.
99999999… has NO alias, so `kms list-aliases` — the only KMS lister — cannot see it.
It used to land in family `kms`, be counted 'covered', and vanish. It must now be
11111111… is the AWS-managed key behind alias/aws/s3: skipped WITH a reason into
manifest.ignored, which is the opposite of a shadow — it must NOT be reported as
undiscovered, or this check invents its own false positives.
The alias ARN is here so the arnResourceType token ('key' vs 'alias') is doing real
work: family `kms` alone cannot separate these two rows.
